title: DATA↔BIZ-001: Data Monetization Strategy + Storage/Processing Cost
description: Business Consultant provides data-product requirements derived from the monetization strategy, subscription-tier definitions (free vs. paid), and business constraints on retention/privacy cost; Data returns cloud storage+processing cost estimates per device per month at target fleet scale, pipeline-architecture options with operational cost profiles, and privacy-compliance implementation cost. Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.11 and BUSINESS_CONSULTANT_SKILL §6.5. NOTE: source unit is cost per device per month at fleet scale; the per-TB framing is captured as an optional secondary field, not the primary unit.

monetization_requirements.description: BIZ→DATA: what the monetization strategy needs from the data platform.

exposure.description: How the data is exposed (API, export, dashboard).

cost_estimates.description: DATA→BIZ: cost profiles at target fleet scale.

cloud_cost_per_device_per_month_usd.description: Storage + processing cost per device per month at target fleet scale (USD).

storage_cost_usd_per_tb_month.description: Optional secondary unit: storage cost per TB per month (USD); null if reported only per-device.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Cost-estimation and monetization-requirement exchange is agent-autonomous. A cost-material platform decision arising from it escalates to an ADR with a BIA (Tier-2).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (at data-monetization-strategy definition; quarterly cloud cost review)
confirm_conditions: monetization_requirements lists data_products with what to capture
every PAID subscription tier defines its analytics_capabilities
cost_estimates report cloud_cost_per_device_per_month_usd at target fleet scale (explicit USD unit)
privacy_compliance_cost_usd provided where retention/privacy constraints apply
reject_conditions: a PAID tier defined without analytics_capabilities (cannot price an undefined product)
cost figure emitted without a currency/unit or as TBD
PII-bearing data product without a SEC privacy-impact escalation (ESC-SEC)
counter_conditions: cost estimate requested at a fleet scale beyond the validated SCALE targets — request scope confirmation
monetization requirement implies new data capture not in the telemetry schema — request a schema-change (ARCH↔DATA-001 / FW↔DATA-001)
